response.justification: While Bogdan brings 15+ years of strong software development experience and demonstrated engineering excellence, this role requires specialized embedded networking security firmware expertise entirely outside his career focus. Critical disqualifying gaps include: no native-level Japanese language proficiency (a required qualification), minimal C programming experience (last used in 2014-2015), no Linux kernel modification experience, and zero security/networking domain knowledge. His expertise in web, cloud, and high-level systems development does not translate to embedded LAN-switch firmware development.
strengths: Extensive 15+ years of software development experience with proven ability to master diverse technology stacks and deliver complex systems
Strong software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD, code quality focus, and mentoring demonstrated across senior-level roles
Linux and infrastructure experience through DevOps work, Docker, and various backend systems development
concerns: No embedded systems security or networking protocol expertise; entire career focused on web, cloud, and high-level application platforms
Insufficient C programming proficiency for embedded firmware development (only 6 months in 2014-2015); primary languages are JavaScript/TypeScript
Missing critical required qualifications: no native-level Japanese language proficiency and no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience

key_factors.factor: Japanese language proficiency requirement not met
No embedded networking security domain experience
Insufficient C programming and Linux kernel expertise
